mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_posting ( source, external_id, company_name, title, job_code, job_category, location, work_address, employment_type, career, education, salary_text, description, deadline_on, until_filled, posted_on, is_active, content_hash, raw, synced_at ) VALUES ( #{source}, #{externalId}, #{companyName}, #{title}, #{jobCode}, #{jobCategory}, #{location}, #{workAddress}, #{employmentType}, #{career}, #{education}, #{salaryText}, #{description}, #{deadlineOn}, #{untilFilled}, #{postedOn}, #{active}, #{contentHash}, #{raw}, NOW() ) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE company_name = new.company_name, title = new.title, job_code = new.job_code, job_category = new.job_category, location = new.location, work_address = new.work_address, employment_type = new.employment_type, career = new.career, education = new.education, salary_text = new.salary_text, description = new.description, deadline_on = new.deadline_on, until_filled = new.until_filled, posted_on = new.posted_on, is_active = new.is_active, content_hash = new.content_hash, raw = new.raw, synced_at = NOW()
